verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's only relevant evidence is that it can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure with "full data ownership". That implies operator control over where data lives and how long it is kept, and the admin dashboard adds user management and server configuration. No retention or deletion controls are documented. missing for 10: documented retention-period settings, explicit data/account deletion controls (cloud or self-hosted), data export/purge workflows, controls over AI-feature data retention, independent corroboration.
